article.title: Why Writing Down a Decision Saves Time Later
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
Teams make many decisions every week. Some decisions are large, such as choosing a new system. Others are small, such as changing a deadline or deciding who will review a document. People often believe they will remember these decisions. A few weeks later, however, memories can be different.

One person may remember that the team approved a plan. Another may remember that the plan was only a suggestion. Someone else may remember a different deadline. The team then spends time reading old messages or discussing the same issue again. A short written decision can prevent this problem.

A useful decision note does not need to be long. It can answer four questions: What did we decide? Why did we decide it? Who owns the next action? When should that action happen? For example: 'We will use Option B because it can be delivered this month. Ken owns the setup and will finish it by August 25.'

Writing the reason is important. Six months later, the team may see a cheaper option and wonder why it was not selected. If the note says that speed was the main requirement, people can understand the old decision in its original context. They can still change the decision, but they do not need to guess what happened.

Decision notes also help new team members. A new person cannot attend meetings that happened before joining the project. Written records show how important choices were made and reduce the need to ask colleagues to explain the same history many times.

The goal is not to record every sentence from every meeting. Too much documentation can become difficult to maintain. Record decisions that affect work, money, responsibilities, deadlines, or future choices. Keep the note short and easy to find.

Good teams do not only make decisions. They make decisions visible. A one-minute note today can save a thirty-minute discussion later. After an important conversation, write down the decision, reason, owner, and deadline. Your future team will have a clearer starting point.
paragraphs.zh: 團隊每週做很多決策，但幾週後不同人的記憶可能不同，於是又花時間翻訊息或重新討論。簡短的 decision note 可以回答四件事：決定了什麼、為什麼、誰負責下一步、期限是何時。留下理由尤其重要，因為未來的人可以理解當時的限制與背景。紀錄也能幫助新加入的成員。不需要逐字記錄所有會議，只要保存會影響工作、金錢、責任、期限或未來選擇的重要決策。今天花一分鐘留下清楚紀錄，可能省下未來三十分鐘的重複討論。
paragraphs.ja: チームでは毎週多くの意思決定をしますが、数週間後には人によって記憶が違うことがあります。その結果、古いメッセージを探したり同じ議論をやり直したりします。短いdecision noteには、何を決めたか、なぜ決めたか、次のownerは誰か、deadlineはいつかを書きます。理由を残すと、将来その判断の背景を理解できます。新しく参加したメンバーにも役立ちます。すべての会話を記録する必要はなく、仕事、費用、責任、期限、将来の選択に影響する決定を短く残します。今日の1分の記録が、将来の30分の再議論を防ぐことがあります。

grammar.body: 強調不只做 A，還應做到更進一步的 B。

business.example: Before we close, what did we decide?
Let's capture the rationale in the decision log.

quiz.question: Why should a decision note include the reason?
quiz.answer: So people can understand the original context later.

quiz.question: Output: Write one short decision note.
quiz.answer: Example: We chose B for speed. I own setup by Friday.
